concerns.text: T005 (Config) and T006c (Data Validation) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T007a/b (Utils) for logging and checksum functions. The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section correctly notes this dependency, yet the [P] tag on T005 and T006c is misleading as they cannot run in parallel with T007a/b without failing. The [P] tag must be removed from T005 and T006c to reflect the strict ordering requirement.

T006b (Curated Data) and T006c (Data Validation) are marked [P] but T006c explicitly depends on T006b to exist ('If missing... raise error'). The 'Dependencies' section acknowledges this, but the [P] tag on T006c is incorrect. T006c cannot run in parallel with T006b; it must strictly follow it. Remove [P] from T006c.

T015 (Simulation Runner) depends on T014 (Topology Generation) to provide .gro/.top files. The 'Dependencies' section notes this, but T015 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in the task list. T015 cannot run in parallel with T014. Remove [P] from T015.

T027 (Summary Table) depends on T026 (Bootstrap) to provide the `bootstrap_stats.csv` output. The 'Dependencies' section correctly states 'T026 must complete before T027', yet T027 is marked [P] in the task list. T027 cannot run in parallel with T026. Remove [P] from T027.

T010 (Generate contracts) is marked [P] and placed in Phase 2.1, but the 'Dependencies' section states 'User Stories (Phase 3+) ... depend on Foundational phase completion'. While T010 is foundational, the 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel'. If T010 generates schemas consumed by T009 (Data Models), it should precede T009. If T009 is the schema definition and T010 is the contract generation, the order is ambiguous. Clarify if T010 depends on T009 or vice versa, and remove [P] if a dependency exists.
